module_summary: AXI-Stream COBS encoder: an input FSM counts non-zero runs, pushing data bytes into a data FIFO and code bytes into a code FIFO; an output FSM interleaves code then segment bytes through a skid output register.

anchors.name: input_state_reg
anchors.why: Input encoder FSM: idle, segment, final zero, append zero

anchors.name: output_state_reg
anchors.why: Output FSM alternating code byte and segment data transfer

anchors.name: input_count_reg
anchors.why: Segment length counter forming COBS code byte, wraps at 254

anchors.name: output_count_reg
anchors.why: Counts remaining segment data bytes after a code byte

anchors.name: fail_frame_reg
anchors.why: Latched error frame flag selecting failed termination code and tuser

anchors.name: code_fifo_in_tdata
anchors.why: Computed COBS code byte pushed into code FIFO

anchors.name: code_fifo_in_tvalid
anchors.why: Pushes a code byte into code FIFO

anchors.name: code_fifo_in_tready
anchors.why: Code FIFO space; gates input ready and final code push

anchors.name: data_fifo_in_tvalid
anchors.why: Pushes non-zero input byte into data FIFO

anchors.name: code_fifo_out_tdata
anchors.why: Code byte popped for output and loading output counter

anchors.name: code_fifo_out_tvalid
anchors.why: Code byte available; starts output of next block

anchors.name: data_fifo_out_tdata
anchors.why: Segment data byte sent to output

anchors.name: data_fifo_out_tvalid
anchors.why: Segment byte available in data FIFO

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata_int
anchors.why: Internal output byte muxed from code or data FIFO

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready gating output FSM transfers

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Skid temp register occupancy flag

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid temp data register used when output stalls

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input byte stream; zero detection drives encoding

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input byte valid

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready when both FIFOs have space and FSM accepts

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End of frame closing out final code

anchors.name: s_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Input frame error marker propagated into encoded frame

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Encoded COBS output byte stream

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output byte valid from output register

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready advancing output skid register

anchors.name: m_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Output end of encoded frame

anchors.name: m_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Output frame error flag

groups.name: Input COBS encoder
groups.description: Detects zeros, counts run length and emits code and data bytes

groups.name: Code FIFO
groups.description: Queues COBS code bytes until their segment is output

groups.name: Output sequencer
groups.description: Sends one code byte then counted segment bytes from data FIFO

groups.name: Output skid register
groups.description: Output register plus temp register providing registered AXI-Stream ready
